principle: Preserve explicit source facts before deciding their Workspace structure.

nodes.symptom: 原文明示动作、材料、时间、事件、条件或歧义未进入事实层
nodes.invariant: 每个事实必须有逐字 evidence span
nodes.detection: source fact inventory has no matching fact node
nodes.genericRegression: 同义动作、并列动作、跨段动作和条件动作

nodes.symptom: 模型原始输出已有事实，但规范化结果删除或改写事实
nodes.invariant: Normalizer 不得增加、删除或改变事实语义
nodes.detection: raw FactGraph fact exists but normalized graph/result does not
nodes.genericRegression: 动词词面不同、同一事件多种动作表达

nodes.symptom: 把事件本身与用户参加、签到、走台等义务互相吞并
nodes.invariant: Event 表达发生了什么，Task 表达用户必须做什么；两者可同时存在并显式关联
nodes.detection: event exists with explicit obligation but only one side is planned
nodes.genericRegression: 会议、演出、培训、报到、维护通知

nodes.symptom: requiresAction=false 时连同明确 Event/TimePoint 一并清空
nodes.invariant: 纯信息可无 Task，但不得丢失明确 Event、TimePoint 和 Evidence
nodes.detection: information-only source has explicit event/time but result arrays are empty
nodes.genericRegression: 系统维护、结果公示、场地变更、停课通知

nodes.symptom: 傍晚、稍后、近期等模糊时间被转换为确定时间
nodes.invariant: relative/vague 必须 normalizedValue=null 且 needsConfirmation=true
nodes.detection: precision is relative/vague with a concrete normalized value or no confirmation
nodes.genericRegression: 模糊时段、相对日期、跨午夜表达

nodes.symptom: 报名截止、提交截止、任务截止与事件开始混淆
nodes.invariant: TimePoint role belongs to the fact relation, not to a title keyword rewrite
nodes.detection: same time fact changes role between FactGraph and planned result
nodes.genericRegression: 报名、报送、提交、到场与结果公布

nodes.symptom: 适用资格、前置条件或触发条件未进入歧义确认
nodes.invariant: Condition 独立成事实；用户是否满足条件未知时必须产生 Ambiguity
nodes.detection: condition exists without a represented ambiguity or target relation
nodes.genericRegression: 仅限、如果、若、通过后、未满足时

nodes.symptom: Planner 创建了无对应 obligation 或无逐字证据的任务
nodes.invariant: 每个 Task 必须映射到且只映射到已冻结 obligation
nodes.detection: planned task cannot be matched to a FactGraph obligation
nodes.genericRegression: 背景材料、联系方式、地址、格式说明不冒充任务

nodes.symptom: 冻结 Expected 将盲评认为合理或必要的结构判为 spurious
nodes.invariant: 严格分与语义等价/用户影响分并列报告，禁止修改 Expected 刷分
nodes.detection: contract preservation improves while frozen strict score regresses on the same fact
nodes.repairBoundary: independent adjudication and scorer contract, never expected rewriting
nodes.genericRegression: 纯信息事件、事件义务双表示、合理任务分组
